en: Dependent on a root phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, there arises a non-root phenomenon not associated with pleasant feeling by way of root condition.

Dependent on a root phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, there arises a non-root phenomenon not associated with painful feeling by way of root condition. [Dependent on a root phenomenon associated with] pleasant feeling...

A non-root phenomenon arises with root condition. Dependent on a non-root phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, a non-root phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises with root condition.
Dependent on a non-root phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, [a non-root phenomenon] associated with painful feeling arises...
Rootless and non-root phenomena arise by way of root condition in association with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling.
In dependence on a rootless phenomenon associated with painful feeling, a non-root phenomenon associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arises by way of root condition … three.
